---
title: "Bayesian inference, interactively"
---

An interactive textbook chapter on Bayesian inference. All Python code runs
in your browser via [Pyodide](https://pyodide.org) — no server needed.

Topics: priors, posteriors, conjugacy, MCMC, variational inference.

> Work in progress. See the [Spike](spike.qmd) page for the technical test.
